if.test: ctx.scope != null and ctx.scope.name() != "COMPANY" and ctx.userIdList != null and ctx.userIdList.size() > 0

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.call_duration), 2), 0) FROM call_record t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.call_status = 2 AND t.call_duration IS NOT NULL AND t.call_start_time >= #{start} AND t.call_start_time <= #{end}

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.quality_score), 2), 0) FROM call_record t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.quality_status = 2 AND t.quality_score IS NOT NULL AND t.call_start_time >= #{start} AND t.call_start_time <= #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.call_start_time, '%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM call_record t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.call_start_time >= #{start} AND t.call_start_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.call_start_time, '%m-%d'), DATE(t.call_start_time) ORDER BY DATE(t.call_start_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.call_start_time, '%Y-%m') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count FROM call_record t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.call_start_time >= #{start} AND t.call_start_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.call_start_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label

SELECT t.caller_user_id AS callerUserId, COALESCE(MAX(su.real_name), MAX(t.caller_user_name)) AS callerUserName, COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN t.call_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS connected, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN t.call_status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN t.call_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN t.call_status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) END AS connectedRate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.call_status = 2 THEN t.call_duration ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalDurationSec, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.call_status = 2 AND t.call_duration IS NOT NULL THEN t.call_duration END), 2), 0) AS avgDurationSec, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.quality_status = 2 AND t.quality_score IS NOT NULL THEN t.quality_score END), 2), 0) AS avgQualityScore FROM call_record t LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = t.caller_user_id AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.caller_user_id IS NOT NULL AND t.call_start_time >= #{start} AND t.call_start_time <= #{end}
GROUP BY t.caller_user_id ORDER BY totalCalls DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT t.id, t.caller_user_id AS callerUserId, t.caller_user_name AS callerUserName, t.contact_name AS contactName, t.phone_number AS phoneNumber, t.call_duration AS callDuration, t.quality_score AS qualityScore, t.call_start_time AS callStartTime, t.recording_url AS recordingUrl FROM call_record t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.quality_status = 2 AND t.quality_score IS NOT NULL AND t.call_start_time >= #{start} AND t.call_start_time <= #{end}
ORDER BY t.quality_score ASC, t.call_start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
